notes: Pair of literature_arts-replace-0018: removes the original fact, that 'has the key signature' is functional. Instances give one signature and ask whether another is excluded; each becomes "does not know". Residual risk: a model that knows the keys will say "yes" from music theory, which means a kept property or a route around the removal, not a failed removal.
